Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python / React)

We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build and scale our hiring platform.
You will design REST APIs in Python with FastAPI, build responsive web applications in
React and TypeScript, and own features end to end from the database to the browser.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
- Develop reusable React components with TypeScript and modern state management.
- Model data and write efficient queries in PostgreSQL.
- Containerize services with Docker and deploy them to AWS.
- Write unit tests and take part in code reviews in an agile team.

Requirements
- 4+ years of professional software development experience.
- Strong Python and React skills; experience with TypeScript.
- Solid understanding of PostgreSQL, Docker and cloud deployment on AWS.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git.
